sentences.en: He claimed that the enormous property was at his disposal.
sentences.zh: 他声称那庞大的财产在他掌控之下。

sentences.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
sentences.zh: 美国喜欢自诩是一个‘无阶级’社会。

sentences.en: He has a claim to be called Europe's leading statesman.
sentences.zh: 他堪称欧洲首屈一指的政治家。

主张, 断言 - 要求
